# Calcula las métricas del informe a partir de precios medios mensuales (dic 2016 - oct 2026).
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
d = pd.read_csv('fred_raw.csv').merge(pd.read_csv('gold.csv').rename(columns={'Date':'month','Price':'gold'}), on='month')
cols = ['spx','ndq','btc','gold','eurusd']
names = {'spx':'S&P 500','ndq':'Nasdaq Composite','btc':'Bitcoin','gold':'Oro','eurusd':'EUR/USD'}
df = d.set_index('month')[cols]; df.index = pd.to_datetime(df.index)
ret = df.pct_change().dropna()
yrs = (len(df)-1)/12
base = df/df.iloc[0]*100
dd = (df/df.cummax()-1)*100
cagr = ((df.iloc[-1]/df.iloc[0])**(1/yrs)-1)*100
vol = ret.std()*np.sqrt(12)*100
serie = []
for m in df.index:
    r = {'month': m.strftime('%Y-%m')}
    for c in cols: r[c]=round(float(df.loc[m,c]),4)
    for c in cols: r[c+'_b']=round(float(base.loc[m,c]),2)
    for c in cols: r[c+'_d']=round(float(dd.loc[m,c]),2)
    serie.append(r)
metricas = [{'key':c,'activo':names[c],'base100':round(float(base[c].iloc[-1]),1),'cagr':round(float(cagr[c]),1),
  'vol':round(float(vol[c]),1),'mdd':round(float(dd[c].min()),1),'mdd_month':dd[c].idxmin().strftime('%Y-%m'),
  'best':round(float(ret[c].max()*100),1),'worst':round(float(ret[c].min()*100),1),
  'ratio':round(float(cagr[c]/vol[c]),2)} for c in cols]
corr = ret.corr()
correl = [{'key':c,'activo':names[c],**{k:round(float(corr.loc[c,k]),2) for k in cols}} for c in cols]
roll = ret['btc'].rolling(12).corr(ret['spx']).dropna()
corr12 = [{'month':m.strftime('%Y-%m'),'corr':round(float(v),2)} for m,v in roll.items()]
yr = df.resample('YE').last().pct_change().dropna()*100
anual = [{'year':str(i.year) if i.year<2026 else '2026*',**{c:round(float(yr.loc[i,c]),1) for c in cols}} for i in yr.index]
dn = ret[ret.spx<0]; up = ret[ret.spx>0]
bajada = [{'key':c,'activo':names[c],'en_caidas':round(float(dn[c].mean()*100),2),'en_subidas':round(float(up[c].mean()*100),2),'n_caidas':int(len(dn)),'n_subidas':int(len(up))} for c in cols]
src = open(__file__).read() if '__file__' in globals() else ''
def meta(extra): return [{'label':'calcular.py','value':src,'type':'code','lang':'python'},{'label':'Entrada','value':'Precios medios mensuales, dic 2016 - oct 2026 (119 meses)'}]+extra
for n,rows,ex in [('serie',serie,[]),('metricas',metricas,[]),('correl',correl,[]),('corr12',corr12,[]),('anual',anual,[]),('bajada',bajada,[])]:
    json.dump({'rows':rows,'meta':meta(ex)},open(f'{n}.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
    print(n,len(rows),len(open(f'{n}.json').read()),'bytes')
